per_case.invention: A method for training a deep neural network by adjusting weights via backpropaga

judge.comment: All three chosen classes fit: backpropagation training maps to G06N 3/08, the neural network structure to G06N 3/02, and object recognition in images to G06V, each with directly supporting quotes and reasonable confidences.

per_case.invention: A rechargeable lithium-ion secondary battery cell with improved electrode chemis

judge.comment: Both chosen classes correctly capture a rechargeable lithium-ion secondary battery cell: H01M 10/00 for secondary cells and the broader H01M parent, each backed by directly relevant evidence. Confidences are reasonable, and the assistant sensibly avoided the vehicle-control and unrelated candidates.

per_case.invention: An automotive driver-assistance system that estimates road conditions and contro

judge.comment: All four classes fit: B60W 40/00 covers road-condition estimation, B60W 30/00 covers speed/steering drive control, and G01S 17/00 and 13/00 correctly map to lidar and radar respectively. Evidence quotes directly support each class, and confidences are reasonable given the explicit text (though the lidar/radar evidence is shared, both sensor types are named).

per_case.invention: A cryptographic protocol for verifying the identity of a user during secure comm

judge.comment: Both chosen classes fit precisely: H04L 9/32 matches identity verification via digital signatures, and H04L 9/00 is the correct parent for cryptographic secure communications; the quoted evidence directly supports each, and confidences are appropriately calibrated. No obviously-better candidate (e.g., public-key subclasses) was ignored since the description does not specify a signature algorithm.

per_case.invention: A wearable device that measures a patient's physiological signals for diagnostic

judge.comment: Both A61B 5/00 and its parent A61B genuinely fit a wearable that measures physiological signals for diagnosis and identifies the wearer, and the evidence quotes directly match. Confidences are reasonable, with the more specific class rated higher.

per_case.invention: A cryptographic communications system in which a message is encoded as a number
per_case.source: Real patent: US 4,405,829 (RSA public-key cryptosystem, granted 1983, expired) — abstract, condensed; real CPC classifications include H04L 9/302 and H04L 9/30

judge.comment: The invention is a textbook description of RSA, so H04L 9/302 (integer factorization/RSA) is the precise class with strong supporting evidence, and its parent classes H04L 9/30 and H04L 9/00 are correct hierarchical fits. Evidence quotes genuinely support each class and confidences are well-calibrated (highest for the exact RSA match, lower for the broader parents).

per_case.invention: A speech recognition system that converts spoken commands into text by analysing

judge.comment: G10L squarely covers speech recognition and audio signal analysis, and the quoted evidence directly matches; the high confidence is justified given the exact fit. No better candidate was ignored (neural-network classes are not indicated by the text).

per_case.invention: A radar system that determines the distance and velocity of an aircraft by measu

judge.comment: Both G01S 13/00 (radio-wave reflection radar) and its parent G01S fit precisely; the invention explicitly uses reflected radio waves, time delay, and Doppler shift to find distance and velocity. Evidence quotes directly support both classes and confidences are appropriately high.

per_case.invention: A programme-controlled robotic manipulator arm that picks components from a conv

judge.comment: Both B25J 9/00 (programme-controlled manipulators) and the parent B25J class fit the described programme-controlled robotic manipulator arm perfectly, and the quoted evidence directly supports each. Confidences are appropriately high given the near-verbatim match, with no overclaiming.

per_case.invention: A method of image analysis that segments object boundaries in a bitmap image and

judge.comment: Both classes fit well: G06T 7/00 directly covers image analysis with segmentation/contour extraction, and the parent G06T is a sound broader class. Evidence quotes directly support each, and confidences are reasonable given the strong textual match.

per_case.invention: A mobile payment system that authorises contactless transactions between a phone

judge.comment: G06Q 20/00 is the core fit for a mobile payment system, strongly supported by the evidence and high confidence. H04W 4/00 is a reasonable secondary fit for the wireless/contactless aspect at a moderate 0.72 confidence, and its evidence quote about contactless transactions between phone and terminal supports the wireless-service class without overclaiming.

per_case.invention: A new recipe for a gluten-free sourdough bread using a wild yeast starter and a

judge.comment: The invention is a gluten-free sourdough bread recipe, which properly belongs in food classes (e.g., A21D) not present among the candidates; none of the offered classes (batteries, surgery, image processing, ML, etc.) genuinely fit, and even C12N (micro-organisms) would be a forced stretch for a recipe. Abstaining is the correct, non-overclaiming choice.
